x-blast.desc: Use crossed feet to cleave through the ball and launch it like a beam of light forged from sheer fighting spirit.

shadow-ray.desc: Light born from darkness turns into a destructive ray in this move that unifies light and shadow.

shadow-ray-earth.desc: Light born from darkness turns into a destructive ray in this move that unifies light and shadow.

chaos-break.desc: This chaotic strike that combines God Break with Fire Blizzard destroys everything in its path.

god-break.desc: A divine ultimate technique that uses brilliantly beautiful golden wings that captivate even the gods.

brave-shot.desc: Leap into an overhead kick and drive the ball with a razor-sharp strike that mesmerizes all who watch.

grand-fire.desc: A trio of powerful kicks stokes roaring fire into a mighty ground shot.

gran-fenrir.desc: Three players come together to revive the legendary Fenrir, whose bestial roar tears through the goal.

the-earth.desc: A super special move created by David Evans that unites the will of all 11 players.

koutei-penguin-3gou.desc: Summon a penguin huddle by whistling, and gather energy as they circle around.

the-galaxy.desc: Channel the power of God Hand to leap across the cosmos and slam a cosmic shot.

fire-blizzard.desc: This double shot pits the opposing powers of ice and fire against each other to form a swirling vortex.

fire-blizzard-fire.desc: This double shot pits the opposing powers of ice and fire against each other to form a swirling vortex.

dark-phoenix.desc: Transform a ball surrounded by dark aura into a phoenix to amplify its original power.

space-penguin.desc: Launch penguins equipped with spacesuits off into space, who'll reenter the atmosphere and go for the goal!

prime-legend.desc: The team's power crystallizes around the ball, and a dazzling twin shot shines forth.

gaia-break.desc: Three players' auras smash the ground apart. Ball and boulder explode in a brutal strike.

supernova.desc: The strongest of moves perfected by The Genesis. Its power far exceeds the boundaries of football known to man.

death-zone-2.desc: An ultimate technique, developed as an improvement for Death Zone. When three personalities collide, immense power is unleashed.

dark-matter.desc: Gather dark matter from outer space around the ball and unleash hell on the opposing team's goalkeeper.

the-hurricane.desc: Mix a blizzard and storm together to generate an ultra-destructive hurricane shot.

maximum-fire.desc: Infuse the left foot with a blazing sword that rips through the ground on its way to the goal.

the-birth.desc: Two extremely heightened powers fuse together to create the DNA of a new move.

double-jaw.desc: A shot that approaches the goal in a zigzag manner, like fangs rushing to crush their prey.

koutei-penguin-x.desc: An emperor penguin born from darkness. Its aura of hate devours all.

koutei-penguin-1gou.desc: A forbidden ultimate technique that unleashes penguins who peck at feet with savage force.

heaven-drive.desc: The ball rises into the clouds and descends sharply, surrounded by light, as if dealing out divine punishment.

unicorn-boost.desc: Two players volley in unison to summon a unicorn that charges straight for the goal.

tiger-storm.desc: Deadly special move that combines the power of Fireball Storm and Tiger Drive.

tenkuu-otoshi.desc: A cosmic shot that crashes with heavenly force as a storm of stars fall from outer space.

twin-boost-f.desc: A combo move that works together with Fire Tornado by boosting its power.

odin-sword.desc: Penetrate the goal using the aura of Odin's sword, summoned via a magic circle on the ground.

excalibur.desc: A noble aura engulfs the player's raised right foot, forming a massive blade that cleaves the field.

the-phoenix.desc: A flame-clad ball transforms into a phoenix that dives directly for the goal!

strike-samba.desc: Add spin to the ball using fancy footwork and shoot to a Samba beat.

gungnir.desc: Open a portal to outer space on the ground to unleash a shot surrounded by a lance-shaped aura.

dragon-slayer.desc: A blue dragon king spreads its wings and roars, unleashing a fierce yet majestic attack.

triple-boost.desc: Three players run in a straight line and kick the ball to the one ahead to create a triple-boosted long shot.

double-tornado.desc: Combine spinning Back and Fire Tornadoes into a strike that swirls onward.

tri-pegasus.desc: Three players combine powers to summon a Pegasus that rides to the goal from mid-air in a stormy hurricane.

triangle-z.desc: Three players come together to create a combo shot with a Z-shaped trajectory.

wyvern-blizzard.desc: A powerful strike combining the Wyvern Crash and Eternal Blizzard.

wolf-legend.desc: The howling of a wolf, illuminated by moonlight, manifested as a pinpoint shot that roars across the pitch.

northern-impact.desc: An ultimate attack that imprisons the keeper in permafrost. The power dormant in the aurora breaks the opposing ranks.

gladius-arch.desc: Seven glowing swords rip through the air hurtling toward the goal.

death-rain.desc: The ball turns into a weapon of destruction that rains down crimson rays of death.

universe-blast.desc: A double kick opens up a dimension to outer space and the energy is harnessed for a shot of cosmic strength.

atomic-flare.desc: Imbue the ball with explosive solar energy and fire off a shot engulfed in crimson flames.

koutei-penguin-2gou.desc: A move that lessens the burden of Emperor Penguin No. 1. Summon penguins that take to the skies for the empire.

honoo-no-kazamidori.desc: Two players kick the ball with full force and make it fly towards the goal as if with fiery wings.

eagle-buster.desc: Two players soar up like eagles to deliver a powerful twin shot from mid-air.

inazuma-break.desc: Three players charge the ball with thunder and launch it high for a lightning-like shot!

god-knows.desc: Banish even the laws of the universe into oblivion. This overwhelming power is nothing short of a divine act.

bakunetsu-screw.desc: Shoot the ball at the goal while surrounded by whirling flames that burn everything up instantly.

death-zone.desc: Shoot from the Triangle of Death. Synergy between the three players is highly important.

butterfly-dream.desc: Like a butterfly's flapping wings, two perfectly in sync players combine their powers and put the opposition in a trance.

thunder-beast.desc: A jumping side volley that summons a thunder beast. Used to boost a teammate's shot.

ryuusei-blade.desc: Dominate the pitch with a foreboding threat reminiscent of the galaxy and shoot with a comet-like high kick.

astro-gate.desc: Summon a massive black hole to crush all in its path, powering up Astro Break to devastating effect.

pegasus-shot.desc: Faith in yourself summons a Pegasus. This is the solo version of Tri-Pegasus.

revolution-v.desc: The bond of friendship between two players stirs up victorious winds of change.

wyvern-crash.desc: An improved version of Dragon Crash that combines the Wyvern's speed and power.

slingshot.desc: Stretch the ball out to its limits, and use the elastic energy to fire a high-speed shot.

tatsumaki-otoshi.desc: New version of Inazuma Drop where two players work together to execute a whirlwind bicycle kick.

dragon-cannon.desc: Channel draconic power into your legs and blast a fiery sidekick at the goal.

dual-strike.desc: The ball is passed between two players at high speed until it seems to split into two.

dragon-ground.desc: Tear across the pitch like a dragon devouring the earth on its way to the goal.

divine-arrow.desc: Infused with the wrath of God, the ball pierces through all things like a divine arrow.

dokonjou-club.desc: Swing your teammates like a club for a game-changing, hole-in-one strike.

the-typhoon.desc: Rise with a force that could conquer raging seas and fire a storm shot from the eye of the typhoon!

death-spear.desc: Add a powerful spin to the ball by pinching it between both feet until it transforms into a spear-shaped shot.

hellfire.desc: A special move that ignites the ball with hellfire through a powerful kick.

bunshin-shoot.desc: A barely legal move that uses ninja clones to kick the ball from three different angles.

bakunetsu-storm.desc: Passion ignites, exploding into a scorching storm that burns all in its path.

dragon-tornado.desc: A powerful special move that is a combination of Dragon Crash and Fire Tornado.

paladin-strike.desc: All body power flows into a single toe. A dazzling light erupts with the mighty toe kick!

gunshot.desc: Twist the ball between both feet to add a spin that causes it to hurtle down from above like a bullet.

mirage-shoot.desc: A mesmerizing illusion shot where a mirage makes it look like the ball splits into two.

eiffel-drive.desc: Launch a towering shot that celebrates your triumph in a French twist on the legendary Steeple Shot.

reflect-buster.desc: An unpredictable shot that bounces off fragments of the ground floating in the air.

megalodon.desc: A giant shark appears from among raging waves and attacks the opposing team's goalkeeper.

ganymede-proton.desc: This isn't a handball, it's a kick! After gathering an enormous amount of energy, take aim, and shoot!

tiger-drive.desc: Crouch down like a predator hunting prey until the illusion of a tiger can be seen behind the player.

inazuma-1gou.desc: Two players move in perfect sync, unleashing a powerful combo shot in a show of friendship.

astro-break.desc: Infuse the ball with multidimensional energies to travel at high speeds with a destructive rotational force.

twin-boost.desc: Two players kick the ball to each other at full force to amplify the power of the final shot.

security-shot.desc: Flick the ball up and lock it with four keys to secure a straight path to the goal.

megane-crash.desc: Who cares if your glasses break? It's worth it if it makes the ball change trajectory!

tsuutenkaku-shoot.desc: The ball flies high up into the air and plunges down at high speed while spinning.

inazuma-otoshi.desc: Use a large player's body as a springboard to shoot a high ball down like lightning from the sky.

kung-fu-attack.desc: Each move is charged with power, then unleashed. A master's skill learned only by kung fu experts.

eternal-blizzard.desc: Sharpened focus summons freezing snow and conjures up a blizzard at the goal area.

dokonjou-bat.desc: Grab a teammate to use as a bat in an ultimate show of mutual trust.

tkachev-bomber.desc: One player makes an acrobatic flip with the help of another and uses the momentum to strike the ball with the hip.

jumping-thunder.desc: Power up a mighty header and strike the ball with a lightning-fast downward volley.

hawk-shot.desc: Have your allies boost you skyward and fire a shot as you dive at blistering speed.

tsunami-boost.desc: Ride a massive wave and perform an impressive long shot that rips through the water toward the goal.

shine-drive.desc: Unleash an impossibly bright drive shot that blinds the goalkeeper.

dark-tornado.desc: A dark tornado of forbidden power engulfs the goal with its cursed flames.

rainbow-loop.desc: A restorative long shot that paints a rainbow over the pitch.

kung-fu-head.desc: Utilize kung fu moves to supercharge the strength of a header shot.

double-grenade.desc: Drop kick the ball with both feet for double the power and send it flying like a rapid bullet.

rose-splash.desc: Every beautiful rose hides its thorns. Graceful moves unleash this bewitching shot.

dynamite-shoot.desc: Blast the goal with an explosive overhead kick that shakes the net.

back-tornado.desc: Rise high up like a bright blue tornado and aim for the goal using a spinning back heel kick.

megaton-head.desc: Launch a header, hitting the ball with a giant hand raised above the head.

cross-drive.desc: A drive shot carried along by a cross-shaped aura formed through powerful kicks in two intersecting directions.

dragon-crash.desc: Harry the opposition with a merciless roar borne from a dragon's might.

run-ball-run.desc: Dash atop the ball to accelerate it so it blasts for the goal with boosted speed.

kurukuru-head.desc: Spin with the ball and strike a dizzying header straight at the goal.

freeze-shot.desc: Freeze your surroundings with a glacier stare, and unleash a fearsome ice-cold shot.

patriot-shoot.desc: The ball is kicked high up and rockets to the goal like a missile.

fire-tornado.desc: Unleash a fiery shot from midair. The deadly ball enveloped in flames pierces straight to the goal.

condor-dive.desc: Leap up and dive sharply headfirst toward the ball, like a condor aiming for prey.

meteor-attack.desc: Slam the ball to send it crashing like a meteor straight toward the goal!

tsuchi-daruma.desc: The ball rolls along the ground and builds power, turning into a crushing dirt ball strike.

hyakuretsu-shot.desc: Deliver a series of frenzied kicks to the ball before unleashing a super shot from mid-air.

kamikakushi.desc: Make the ball vanish and reappear, confounding the keeper at the last second.

suisei-shoot.desc: Rain the ball down like a blazing comet, leaving a trail of light in its wake.

phantom-shoot.desc: Manifest eerie ball-shaped will-o'-the-wisps to confuse the goalkeeper.

abisegeri.desc: Kick the ball up with your knee and hammer it down with a sharp heel kick.

grenade-shot.desc: Twist the body to build power and drive it into the ball all at once for a knockout special move.

rolling-kick.desc: Execute artistic mid-air somersaults to build power for an acrobatic shot.

psycho-shot.desc: Lift and control the ball midair with psychokinetic power, then slam it into the goal.

spiral-shot.desc: Spin the ball to build energy, and hit the goal with a swirling, piercing shot.

snake-shot.desc: Strike with a serpentine drive that twists and coils, leaving the keeper bewildered.

tarzan-kick.desc: Swing from vine to vine like Tarzan and use the momentum to unleash a forceful shot.

spinning-shoot.desc: Rush at the goal like a destructive tornado. The move is difficult to control, but will never miss.

killer-fields.desc: Two players kick the ball to add a powerful spin that conjures up a purple vortex and blows opponents away.

air-ride.desc: Transform the ball into a surfboard that can be mounted and used to jump past opponents.

boost-glider.desc: Team up for an explosive speed boost. A flying combination move powered by friendship.

triple-dash.desc: Bolt forward with two allies as an unstoppable trio that barrels through defenders.

the-ikaros.desc: Legendary wings sprout against the sun and the bright light that results blinds the opponents, allowing for a breakthrough.

angel-ball.desc: The ball grows a pair of angelic white wings, making the opponent lose their will to fight.

devil-ball.desc: The ball grows a pair of devilish black wings, mocking and confusing the opponent.

super-el-stico.desc: The ball sticks to your feet like magic, dribbling in midair without ever falling.

water-veil.desc: Keep opponents away by creating a barrier using water that spurts out from the ground.

fuujin-no-mai.desc: A wild dance too fast for the naked eye to perceive! Trap the opposition in a violent vortex.

flame-veil.desc: Keep opponents away by creating a barrier using fire that gushes forth from the ground.

dual-pass.desc: Trade lightning-fast passes until the ball looks like it's multiplied mid-dribble.

southern-crosscut.desc: The cosmic energy and the hunger to win combine to form a cross-shaped explosion that blows away the opposition.

ninin-sankyaku.desc: A challenging dribble move where two players run in sync and carry the ball all the way to the goal.

heaven-s-time.desc: Pause time and gracefully bypass the defence. A natural aptitude is necessary to learn this move.

dash-storm.desc: Charge ahead while generating a whirlwind and blast approaching opponents into the sky.

jigoku-guruma.desc: Two players form a whirling wheel and slam into opponents, sending them flying.

aikidou.desc: Synchronize with a teammate to release a sweeping shockwave that trips the opponent.

armadillo-circus.desc: Ride a giant ball with the Super Armadillo Rodeo Clown and smash through enemies.

matador-feint.desc: Whip a red cape to provoke the opponent and easily step away when they charge madly.

u-boat.desc: Dive beneath the surface like a submarine, reading the opponent's movements as you break through.

liar-shot.desc: Whip up a gust and blow opponents away in a whirlwind of festive fun.

echo-ball.desc: Pull opponents into another dimension and shatter their focus with a single, haunting strike.

ultra-moon.desc: Execute a series of backflips with the ball against a moonlit sky, ending with a perfect moonsault.

oouchiwa.desc: Whip up a sudden gust with a giant fan to blow opponents away in a move full of festive flair.

reppuu-dash.desc: Unleash a souped-up Flurry Dash and blaze past opponents in a streak of fire.

toumei-feint.desc: Bend the foe's vision and vanish like a ghost to then slip past like an invisible gust.

bunshin-feint.desc: A high level ninja move that confuses the opponent by splitting into three fast-moving ninja clones.

mogura-shuffle.desc: Use a mole fake that leaves the opponent guessing: will the buried ball strike, or is it just an illusion?

meteor-shower.desc: An overhead strike sends the ball crashing down, raining to earth like a blazing meteor.

aurora-dribble.desc: Manifest aurora lights and breeze past your opponents while they're mesmerized.

dog-run.desc: The ball dodges and confuses the opponent as if it has a will of its own.

scissors-bomb.desc: Trigger an explosion at your feet, masking your advance in a cloud of smoke.

prima-donna.desc: Execute an elegant dance that tempts the opponent to dance along.

maboroshi-dribble.desc: Use tricky movements to create an illusion of the player to deceive the opponent while dribbling.

tatsumaki-dokugiri.desc: Spin the ball and scatter a cloud of toxic mist, blinding opponents in a whirlwind of chaos.

kamaitachi.desc: Dash in with slicing speed, wrapped in the fury of a raging whirlwind.

warp-drive.desc: Open a tiny black hole and dash through warp space to reappear ahead.

mogura-feint.desc: Apply pressure on the ball to bury it and charge forward underground like an actual mole.

zanzou.desc: Move so fast the eye can't keep up. Dodge rivals with this ninja technique.

kangaroo-kick.desc: Kick the ball forward with both feet, in a move inspired by the kangaroo's jump.

ribbon-shower.desc: Spin your rhythmic ribbons to dazzle opponents and glide past the defence in a flourish.

gorimuchuu.desc: Do a bizarre dance with pattering feet to stir up a cloud of dust that blocks visibility.

zigzag-spark.desc: Electrocute nearby opponents with the spark of passion that occurs from the friction of this zigzag dribble.

super-armadillo.desc: Curl up like an armadillo and rapidly spin forward, clutching the football while crashing through opponents.

super-scan-of.desc: Take in the opponent's rhythm at a glance and slip past the defence with precision.

moonsault.desc: Twist and flip like a gymnast, vaulting clean over your opponent's head.

fuusen-gum.desc: Inflate the ball like a giant bubble and burst it to blast defenders away.

dokugiri-no-jutsu.desc: Unleash a toxic mist to stagger opponents and dash through the opening.

magic.desc: Slip past in an instant with a vanishing act that defies explanation.

shippuu-dash.desc: Buffet the opposition into disarray with speed like the wind! Can only be mastered by lightweight players.

tamanori-pierrot.desc: Ride the ball at breakneck speed, dazzling defenders with acrobatic flair.

monkey-turn.desc: Jump around the opponent like an agile monkey and slip past their defences.

noroi.desc: Envelop your foe in a curse to slow them, then dash right past.

hitori-one-two.desc: Add a strong backspin to the ball that enables the player to do a solo double touch.

dash-accel.desc: Accelerate to full speed to execute a super dribble move that can't be stopped.

tatsumaki-senpuu.desc: Spin the ball to generate a cyclone that kicks up dirt to blind the opponent.

body-shield.desc: Three players line up and support the player in front so that the first player can use their body to put up a strong guard.

hurricane-arrow.desc: Rush at a cyclone-caught opponent like a piercing arrow while the referee is looking away.

perfect-tower.desc: Unleash an electrifying double attack on the enemy from the top of a looming tower.

kagome-kagome.desc: Three players form a circle and all slide in at once trapping your rival like a bird in a cage.

mad-express.desc: A triple-train-threat that seems silly, until it hits: blasting opponents away with awesome force.

sigma-zone.desc: Once locked on, there's no escape. Three players converge for this coordinated attack!

ground-quake.desc: Unleash a mighty punch that shakes the ground, stopping everything in its path.

the-mountain.desc: A greatly powered-up version of The Wall that summons a towering mountain to block opponents.

no-escape.desc: Raise up stone barriers from the earth, forming a narrow path of no escape before stealing the opponent's ball.

demon-cut.desc: Execute a hair-raising roundhouse kick that sends out a diabolical shockwave.

barbarian-no-tate.desc: Manifest a shield infused with barbarian strength to intimidate and repel any assault.

rock-wall-dam.desc: Combine The Wall with God Hand to block charging enemies like a dam.

frozen-steal.desc: Obstruct the opposition's advance by freezing the pitch. Shut them out completely at absolute zero.

harvest.desc: A double sliding tackle executed at full force that cleanly reaps the opponent's ball away.

roadroller-tackle.desc: Barrel through defenders with a crushing tackle to flatten everything in your path.

whale-guard.desc: Sound a conch to summon a giant whale that devours opponents and the ball with its massive jaws.

planet-shield.desc: Summon a colossal planet overhead and crush opponents with a cosmic-scale strike.

double-cyclone.desc: Two players generate a rampaging cyclone that ruthlessly blasts the opponent away.

asteroid-belt.desc: Call upon a meteor shower from outer space to repel the incoming opposition.

dual-storm.desc: Harness the fiery power of two, whipping up a scorching wind to snatch the ball.

shooting-star.desc: Jump high up using another player as a stepping stone and dive down swiftly like a shooting star for a sliding tackle.

block-circus.desc: Jump above the opponent to distract them while another player steals the ball.

snow-angel.desc: Freeze the opponent into a giant ice block using snow crystals born from frigid winds.

sabaki-no-tettsui.desc: Summon a colossal foot from above to crush defenders like a hammer of justice.

senpuujin.desc: Rotate at high frequencies like a prankster's toy top, creating whirlwinds that are difficult to contend with.

sneaking-raid.desc: Stay hidden and strike from behind to ambush enemies before they notice what's happening.

shinkuuma.desc: Use a kick to create a tear in space that sucks in the ball and reduces its power.

mega-quake.desc: Break the ground apart with a devastating quake that blows everything away.

iron-wall.desc: This looming wall is an ironclad defence that strikes fear into the heart of opponents.

volcano-cut.desc: A sharp spin kick, causing an eruption of flames! The wall of fire will blow away opponents and  stop their breakthrough.

bunshin-defense.desc: Split into three and send one person to attack while the other two steal the ball.

rolling-slide.desc: Overtake the opponent using high-speed backflips and steal the ball with a sliding tackle.

heavy-baby.desc: Harness gravity to turn the ball into a weight and swing defenders around like ragdolls.

stone-prison.desc: Imprison the opponent with stone pillars from the ground and steal the ball from them.

the-tower.desc: From atop a sky-high tower, call down lightning strikes onto the opposition, leaving them no chance even to cry out.

profile-zone.desc: Analyze and profile the opponent's data to find an opening to steal the ball.

cyclone.desc: Deliver a sharp kick that stirs up a cyclone around the opponent and carries them, ball and all, into the air.

gravitation.desc: An invincible supergravity field emerges, manipulating gravity to render enemies immobile.

kage-nui.desc: Create and control a giant hand shadow to catch the opponent's shadow by weaving through the ground.

flame-dance.desc: Use fiery breakdancing moves to steal the ball from the opponent.

good-smell.desc: Sprinkle a dreamy scent to lull foes into deep sleep and seize the ball.

power-charge.desc: Focus all your strength into a shoulder tackle and snatch the ball.

gravestone.desc: Hit the ground with full strength to make stone pillars jut out and send the opponent flying.

welcome-back.desc: Kick to spin the ball and reel it back like a tethered yo-yo.

desert-storm.desc: Kick up a cloud of sand, blind the opponent, and snatch the ball while they stagger.

zigzag-flame.desc: Run forward in a zigzag manner to start a fire while charging towards the opponent.

spinning-cut.desc: A sharp roundhouse creates a crescent of blue energy that blasts opponents aside with great force!

earthquake.desc: Shake the ground by stomping down from mid-air and steal the ball from the opponent when they fall.

jibashiri-kaen.desc: Steal the ball with a fiery roundhouse kick, Taekwondo-style.

kumo-no-ito.desc: Spread a spider web on the ground that makes movement difficult.

fake-bomber.desc: Steal the ball and swap it for a fake, tricking opponents with an upgraded version of Fake Ball.

fake-ball.desc: A dirty move that finds an opening to secretly switch the ball with a fake one.

the-wall.desc: Harness the power of the earth to raise a wall, blocking the way and proving yourself a mighty defender.

ushiro-no-shoumen.desc: Strike from behind with a sneaky knee, then snatch the ball while they stagger.

super-scan-df.desc: Take in the opponent's rhythm at a glance and shut down attacks with precision.

ice-ground.desc: An ice skating move that derives power from the conflicting nature between its gracefulness and freezing might.

super-shikofumi.desc: A large foot appears in the sky and stomps on the opponent in this enhanced version of Sumo Stomp.

blade-attack.desc: Slam a foot down to generate a strong shockwave that slices through the ground like a sharp blade.

killer-slide.desc: Wrest for possession of the ball with an aggressive, high-speed slide tackle that conjures countless afterimages.

photon-flash.desc: Spinning in a flash of light, the ball is stolen in the blink of an eye, leaving opponents dazzled.

horn-train.desc: Charge like a raging bull and bulldoze all in your way.

onryou.desc: Those who are caught by these ghostly hands that appear from the ground can never escape.

giant-spin.desc: Spin like a top to whip up a tornado and blast any approaching foes aside.

doppelganger.desc: Confound foes with an eerie double that blocks in your place.

coil-turn.desc: Coil around the opponent quickly to create a wind spiral that blasts the opponent away.

shikofumi.desc: Raise your foot in a mighty sumo stomp to make the ground shake.

quick-draw.desc: Quickly draw close to the opponent and steal the ball before they know what hit them.

the-end.desc: Infuse your right hand with a dark aura that causes incoming shots to vanish into thin air.

omega-the-hand.desc: The God Hand evolves into its ultimate form to catch and crush any shot with ease.

maou-the-hand.desc: Channel anger into energy to manifest a fearsome fiend.

tamashii-the-hand.desc: Overflowing passion manifests a giant right hand. Behold the mighty God Hand!

jikuu-no-kabe.desc: One hand rises, as if freezing time itself, stopping the football's momentum and deflecting it away.

high-voltage.desc: Teammates on each hand of the goalkeeper generate a high-voltage barrier to protect the goal.

holy-zone.desc: A cleansing light from the sky seals up the ball's momentum.

god-catch.desc: A genuine love for football evolves the Majin into a majestic guardian deity of goals.

god-hand-triple.desc: Combine the strength of three into one colossal God Hand for massive power.

million-hands.desc: Pantomime at high speed to create multiple hand shapes that form a shield to block incoming shots.

mugen-no-kabe.desc: Three players raise an impregnable infinite wall together in front of the goal.

beast-fang.desc: Thrust out both hands like a ferocious beast baring fangs at incoming shots.

procyon-net.desc: Like the Winter Triangle in the night sky, a shining barrier of stars protects the goal.

ijigen-the-hand.desc: A variation of God Hand where a dome-shaped aura bursts out from the hand to turn incoming shots aside.

ice-block.desc: Surround a fist with an icy aura before punching the ball to freeze and stop it in an instant.

burnout.desc: Use fiery hands to block incoming shots and reduce the ball to ashes.

drill-smasher.desc: Create a giant drill to stop the ball. Leave the opposition feeling empty, as if boring a hole in their spirits.

mugen-the-hand.desc: Summon innumerable hands to shield the goal, impeding all possible angles of approach.

gigant-wall.desc: The goalkeeper grows bigger by sheer willpower and punches the ball into the ground.

big-spider.desc: Catch and devour incoming shots like a spider catching prey in its web.

triple-defense.desc: Two players support their goalkeeper from behind to stop incoming shots with the power of friendship.

double-rocket.desc: The improved version of Rocket Kobushi that creates two fists of aura energy instead of just one.

flash-upper.desc: Focus while hopping from side to side to unleash an uppercut that negates incoming shots.

god-hand-x.desc: Cross both arms to dash and lunge at the ball, catching it in mid-air.

needle-hammer.desc: Gather electricity into a hand and release it all at once to put a quick stop to incoming shots.

capoeira-snatch.desc: Use good timing to grab the ball between both feet and redirect its trajectory.

bunshin-block.desc: Split into three with ninja precision and slam the ball down from above with triple power.

colosseo-guard.desc: Focus power into both arms to manifest the Colosseum as a stalwart fortress that stops incoming shots.

tsunami-wall.desc: The sea god's roar summons a tall tsunami wave that forms a wall to block off incoming shots.

ikari-no-tettsui.desc: Focus power into a fist and swing it down angrily with the Majin's support to put a stop to incoming shots.

dai-bakuhatsu-harite.desc: Unleash a ferocious streak of fiery sumo slaps on the ball to cause a large explosion that blows it backwards.

storm-rider.desc: A swirling sandstorm sucks in the ball and weakens it enough to be caught.

wormhole.desc: Conjure a portal connected to other planes, swallowing up any kind of shot!

chabudai-gaeshi.desc: Grab a round table-shaped earth fragment and flip it up in a display of sheer anger.

shootrap.desc: Cover the goal with an array of infrared sensors to block every incoming shot.

safety-protect.desc: Countless aura shields block incoming shots, ensuring the safety of the team.

counterstrike.desc: Smash the ball with a full-power counter punch, aiming for a game-changing rebound.

stinger.desc: Focus all force at your fingertips to pierce and stop the ball in a single strike.

galatyn.desc: A brilliant aura transforms into a towering blade that slices incoming shots into two.

great-barrier-reef.desc: The South Pacific Ocean appears before the goal and its currents weaken the strength of incoming shots.

kaenhousha.desc: Take a deep breath and release it along with fiery flames to weaken and catch incoming shots.

seigi-no-tekken.desc: A giant fist of justice protects the goal by punching away incoming shots.

black-hole.desc: Manifest a black hole in your palm to attract and catch incoming shots.

aurora-curtain.desc: Summon a shimmering aurora before the goal, dulling every shot with majestic finesse.

bakuretsu-punch.desc: Pound the ball more than 100 times in a second to repel incoming shots with full force.

dokonjou-catch.desc: Absorb any shot with the softest part of the body and cushion the impact with mastery.

goal-zurashi.desc: Body slam the goalpost to make it slide away for a miraculous save in this barely legal move.

full-power-shield.desc: Gather all of your strength to create a shockwave shield capable of blocking powerful shots.

majin-the-hand.desc: Unyielding heart and burning passion call forth the Majin, an Inazuma legend awakened anew.

majin-the-hand-wood.desc: Unyielding heart and burning passion call forth the Majin, an Inazuma legend awakened anew.

tsumuji.desc: Release whirlwinds from both hands and combine them into one to absorb and negate incoming shots.

slash-nail.desc: Channel your aura into your toes and slash through the ball, slicing it clean with a devastating strike.

nekketsu-head.desc: Headbutt the ball with blazing force and blast back any shot with explosive power.

shoot-pocket.desc: Envelop the ball with a special barrier that greatly reduces its power.

hanafubuki.desc: Use flower petals dancing daintily on the pitch to reduce the power of incoming shots.

kogarashi.desc: Summon a swirling leaf tornado to guard the goal and knock away the ball.

rocket-kobushi.desc: Form a fist of pure aura energy and fire it to crush an oncoming shot.

power-shield.desc: Generate a shockwave shield in front of the goal to repel even the strongest shots.

wild-claw.desc: Harness untamed speed and leap to seize the ball with raw, primal force.

tornado-catch.desc: Spin against the ball's trajectory to sap its power and snatch it from the air.

yugamu-kuukan.desc: Warp space to create a black hole that attracts all shots towards it.

god-hand.desc: Block any and all shots with a giant right hand brimming with passion for football.

god-hand-wood.desc: Block any and all shots with a giant right hand brimming with passion for football.

pressure-punch.desc: Descend from above to punch the ball down, crushing any shot in your path.

makiwari-chop.desc: Chop the ball with the force of an axe swing! Every strike gets slammed to the ground.

toughness-block.desc: Muscles as strong as steel can take any shot head-on.

killer-blade.desc: Slash down with a scythe-like aura, cleaving every shot in two.

nekketsu-punch.desc: Infuse willpower into your right hand to block goal shots by punching them away.

swan-dive.desc: Dive from above the goal and crush the ball with a body slam to stop the shot.
